observations: body L2, L4, L6: the formulas stand in the middle of the line; the minus signs are printed as long dashes and set as minus signs; the label (β) is in the type of the text.
body L8-L9: the head of the notes on chapter 4, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals.
body L11: the second u of «Yūnus» is printed with its right stem drawn up over the line, like ú; it is not an accent.

body L15: a short upright stroke stands between the A and the b of «al-‘Ab-»; it is not a sign. The dash of «al-‘Ab-» measures 4.0 pt, between a hyphen and the longer dash of the names in the following lines; it is transcribed as a hyphen.
body L22: the Arabic words «توجــه» and «بــلاد» are printed with elongations between their letters, kept as printed.
notes_left L1, L5: of the opening parenthesis before «cuius» (L1) only the top printed; the closing parenthesis of L5 is printed broken.
notes_left L11: the hyphen of «condi-» stands low, at the foot of the line.
notes_right L3: the C of «Canonum» is printed broken, its curve and its top apart.
notes_right L11-L12: the t of «t. XX» is printed broken, like l; the opening parenthesis before «ubi» did not print, only a speck stands in its place.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
